title: 50agents vs n8n: self-hosted or built for you | 50agents
description: 50agents vs n8n: n8n is a self-hostable workflow builder with code nodes and per-run pricing; 50agents builds automations, AI agents and apps from plain words.
answer: Pick n8n to self-host, write code nodes and pay one price per run.
Pick 50agents when nobody on the team wants to build: describe the job and Captain does it.
line: Describe the job and Captain builds it, so nobody on the team has to.
ask: Set up an automation: every new Stripe payment is added as a row to my Google Sheet with the customer, amount and date
lede: Self-hosted builder against built-for-you, row by row.

strengths.title: Describe it in plain words
strengths.line: Captain asks a few questions, shows a plan, then builds it.

strengths.title: Automations on events
strengths.line: The same steps on a new order, payment or contact, or on a timer.

strengths.title: You approve what goes out
strengths.line: Emails to clients wait in Needs you until you say yes.

move.title: Download the workflow
move.body: n8n workflows download as JSON. Keep it as your checklist.

move.title: Describe it in a sentence
move.body: For example: every new Stripe payment becomes a row in my Google Sheet.

move.title: Compare, then deactivate n8n
move.body: Run both on a few payments, then switch the n8n workflow off.

faqs.a: No. 50agents runs in the cloud. n8n can run on your own servers.
n8n's directory lists 2,829 integrations. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.
